items.claim: Maersk said Roberta Duarte will rejoin the company as Chief People Officer from 1 November, succeeding Susana Elvira, with Duarte quoted saying she is 'truly honoured to return to Maersk' and that the company 'feels like home'.
items.source: A.P. Moller - Maersk company announcement; quote attributed to Roberta Duarte

items.claim: In a customer advisory Maersk said several severe typhoons (Bavi, Dolphin, Narra, Peilou and Chan-Hom) have caused flooding and congestion, that all 14 of the region's busiest ports are seeing reduced on-time vessel arrivals, and that its Gemini network 'remains the more reliable network'.
items.source: A.P. Moller - Maersk advisory, East Asia typhoon season impacting logistics

items.claim: Maersk told customers it is applying a 'No Movement Reference Number - No Load' policy under EU ICS2 for cargo transiting the European Union, and separately restricted exports of shipper-owned containers from Hungary worldwide.
